主要内容: On February 11, 2020, the Board of Directors of Sangamo Therapeutics, Inc. increased the size of the Board to nine members from eight and appointed Dr. John Markels to fill the newly created vacancy and serve as a director until the Company’s next annual meeting of stockholders or until his successor is elected and qualified. Dr. Markels will receive compensation as a non-employee director in accordance with the Company’s non-employee director compensation practices, including an option to purchase 30,000 shares of common stock and a restricted stock unit award of 5,000 shares under the 2018 Equity Incentive Plan. The appointment was not based on any arrangement or understanding with any person. The Company’s definitive proxy statement for the 2019 Annual Meeting of Stockholders, filed on April 25, 2019, outlines these compensation practices. The Company’s common stock is traded under the ticker symbol SGMO on the Nasdaq Global Select Market.
